query:
INSERT INTO accounts (
            name,
            status,
            lifecycle_stage,
            industry,
            city,
            country,
            employee_count
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            ($2::text)::account_status,
            ($3::text)::account_lifecycle_stage,
            $4,
            $5,
            $6,
            $7
         )
         RETURNING id
